title: boomtime · Domain & Jobs
description: Consolidated domain view (replaces boomtime-daily-review + boomtime-domain-ingest). Top row is boomtime's own Prometheus counters (heartbeats, job runs, limiter events, Hardcover/Amazon calls); the rest is the validated Loki slog narrative — what ran, what domain outcomes landed, what to read in the daily review, and the read-path/ingest failures. Dual datasource (Prometheus mimir + Loki loki-v2) is intentional.

list.name: proc
list.label: Process
list.description: Which boomtime process to read logs from: the always-on server, or the KEDA ScaledJob drain pods that run the offloaded job kinds. The always-on AMQP image worker is gone — RabbitMQ and the imagejobs pipeline were retired (boom-piig), so there is one job system now. Default All covers both and excludes the co-located postgres/dragonfly pods.

list.name: kind
list.label: Job kind
list.description: catalyst-go-jobs kind (the registry key a handler is registered under). Default All is the regex .+, so a NEW kind shows up in the DATA without editing this dashboard — it just will not appear in this picker until added here. Refreshed 2026-08-25 against the kinds actually present in the jobs table; the previous list predated the books liberation, reading-monitor and hardcover pull/match kinds.

list.name: bucket
list.label: Bucket
list.description: Width of each bar/sample in the over-time panels. auto keeps roughly 30 buckets across the selected range.

panels.title: Ingest & jobs — first-party metrics
panels.description: boomtime's own Prometheus counters (scraped via the ServiceMonitor) — exact, unlike the Loki request-count proxies below.

panels.title: Heartbeats ingested (range)
panels.description: Coding heartbeats PERSISTED over the range (real count, not requests).

panels.title: Heartbeat rate
panels.description: Live heartbeat ingest rate.

panels.title: Job success ratio
panels.description: Fraction of terminal job runs that finished done (vs failed/cancelled).

panels.title: Jobs failed (range)
panels.description: Job runs that exhausted retries over the range.

panels.title: Hardcover pushes (range)
panels.description: Hardcover GraphQL calls actually executed (not dry-run-blocked).

panels.title: Heartbeat ingest rate
panels.description: First-party ingest throughput — the replacement for the Loki '.bulk request count' proxy the old Domain Ingest board was forced to use.

panels.title: Job run rate by kind & status
panels.description: Terminal job outcomes per kind (done|failed|retry|cancelled).

panels.title: Job-limiter events by kind & outcome
panels.description: Concurrency-limiter acquired / atlimit / error per job kind.

panels.title: External call rates — Hardcover & Amazon
panels.description: Hardcover (executed|dryrun_blocked) and Amazon (signed|cookie) call rates.

panels.title: AMQP job deliveries by outcome
panels.description: RabbitMQ job deliveries handled by the AMQP provider (absent on the local in-process provider). processed vs requeued.

panels.title: Reading-monitor active books
panels.description: Books the two-level monitor currently has in fine-capture (L2) — i.e. actively being read right now, per source. Driven by the persistent leader-singleton engine, not the admin tab.

panels.title: Reading-monitor advance rate
panels.description: Whispersync location advances detected per second, per source — the raw signal the dedicated cadence board (uid boomtime-reading-monitor) turns into recommended poll intervals.

panels.title: Job runs — what ran, and how it went
Job runs by kind
panels.description: Terminal catalyst-go-jobs outcomes (done + failed) bucketed over time and stacked by kind. This is the 'what did boomtime work on' view: each bar is the mix of domain work that completed in that bucket. Colors are pinned per kind, so a kind keeps its hue when the others drop out.

targets.expr: sum by (kind) (count_over_time({namespace="boomtime", app_kubernetes_io_name=~"$proc"} |~ "jobs: done|jobs: failed" | json | msg =~ `jobs: (done|failed.*)` | kind =~ "$kind" [$bucket]))

panels.title: Job kinds over the range
panels.description: Per-kind tally of completed / retried / failed runs across the whole range. The table is also the colorblind-safe reading of the stacked chart beside it — identity by name, not by hue.

targets.expr: sum by (kind) (count_over_time({namespace="boomtime", app_kubernetes_io_name=~"$proc"} |= "jobs: done" | json | msg = "jobs: done" | kind =~ "$kind" [$__range]))
sum by (kind) (count_over_time({namespace="boomtime", app_kubernetes_io_name=~"$proc"} |= "jobs: retry scheduled" | json | kind =~ "$kind" [$__range]))
sum by (kind) (count_over_time({namespace="boomtime", app_kubernetes_io_name=~"$proc"} |= "jobs: failed (attempts exhausted)" | json | kind =~ "$kind" [$__range]))

panels.title: Job outcomes over time
panels.description: The same runs split by OUTCOME rather than kind: completed, retried, failed. Status colors are reserved (green/amber/red) and each series is named in the legend, so the state never rides on hue alone.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({namespace="boomtime", app_kubernetes_io_name=~"$proc"} |= "jobs: done" | json | msg = "jobs: done" | kind =~ "$kind" [$bucket]))

panels.title: Job failures and retries — with the reason
panels.description: Every terminal failure and scheduled retry, newest first, reformatted to kind / job id / attempt / error. This is the panel to read when the failed-runs stat above is non-zero.

targets.expr: {namespace="boomtime", app_kubernetes_io_name=~"$proc"} |~ "jobs: failed|jobs: retry scheduled|jobs: no handler" | json | msg =~ `jobs: (failed.*|retry scheduled|no handler for kind)` | kind =~ "$kind" | line_format "{{.kind}}  job={{.id}}  attempt={{.attempt}}{{.attempts}}  {{.msg}}  {{.err}}"

panels.title: Wakatime heartbeats imported
panels.description: Heartbeats pulled in by a completed catalyst-waka bulk import (the "imported" total on each "import completed" record), summed over the range. Empty when no import ran — imports are user-triggered, not periodic.

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time({namespace="boomtime", app_kubernetes_io_name=~"$proc"} |= "import completed" | json | unwrap imported [$__range]))

panels.title: Audible library items backfilled
panels.description: Items walked by a completed catalyst-books Audible backfill. This is the one-time history pull, distinct from the periodic forward sync below.

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time({namespace="boomtime", app_kubernetes_io_name=~"$proc"} |= "audible backfill complete" | json | unwrap libraryItems [$__range]))

panels.title: Books newly finished
panels.description: Titles the Audible forward sync saw flip to finished in the range — the domain event that drives a Hardcover push.

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time({namespace="boomtime", app_kubernetes_io_name=~"$proc"} |= "audible forward: newly finished" | json | unwrap count [$__range]))

panels.title: Pushed to Hardcover
panels.description: Finished books successfully written out to Hardcover. Note the deployment may be in DRY-RUN (BOOM_HARDCOVER_DRYRUN) — check the warning feed at the bottom, where the dry-run banner is logged on every boot.

panels.title: Label-image generation runs
panels.description: Outcome of each labelimages sweep: images generated, candidates skipped because artwork already existed, and entries that failed. Stacked, so bar height is the size of the sweep.

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time({namespace="boomtime", app_kubernetes_io_name=~"$proc"} |= "labelimages: run complete" | json | unwrap generated [$bucket]))
sum(sum_over_time({namespace="boomtime", app_kubernetes_io_name=~"$proc"} |= "labelimages: run complete" | json | unwrap skipped_existing [$bucket]))
sum(sum_over_time({namespace="boomtime", app_kubernetes_io_name=~"$proc"} |= "labelimages: run complete" | json | unwrap failed [$bucket]))

panels.title: Domain outcome feed
panels.description: The plain-language record of what boomtime accomplished: imports finishing, Audible backfills and forward syncs, Hardcover pushes, avatars and label artwork saved. Read this top-to-bottom for the daily recap.

targets.expr: {namespace="boomtime", app_kubernetes_io_name=~"$proc"} |~ "import completed|audible backfill complete|audible forward: newly finished|hardcover: pushed finished book|labelimages: run complete|labelimages: saved|avatar regen: saved" | json | line_format "{{.msg}}  {{.user}}{{.id}}"

panels.title: Kindle reading minutes (range)
panels.description: Reconstructed Kindle reading time that LANDED as reading_activity over the range (seconds counter → minutes). Empty during the diagnostic-only phase — the monitor measures + toasts but writes no reading_activity until the cadence is trusted.

panels.title: Reading activity landed (rate)
panels.description: reading_activity seconds accruing per wall-second, per source — the forward-composition signal into the fusion layer, once the monitor emits it.

panels.title: Consumption — what is the data being asked for?
Most-requested domain endpoints
panels.description: Top read paths over the range. This is the demand side of the domain: which stats, timelines and widgets are actually being pulled, and how hard. Static asset and health-probe traffic is filtered out.

targets.expr: topk(20, sum by (path) (count_over_time({namespace="boomtime", app_kubernetes_io_name=~"$proc"} |~ "/api/" | json | msg = "http request" | method = "GET" | path =~ `/api/.+` [$__range])))

panels.title: Read-path errors by status
panels.description: GET requests to the domain API answered 4xx or 5xx. A rising 5xx here usually means an aggregation query is failing and the dashboard cards are rendering empty for the user.

targets.expr: sum by (status) (count_over_time({namespace="boomtime", app_kubernetes_io_name=~"$proc"} |~ "/api/" | json | msg = "http request" | method = "GET" | path =~ `/api/.+` | status >= 400 [$bucket]))

panels.title: Top warnings and errors
panels.description: Distinct WARN/ERROR messages over the range, most frequent first. Work down this list; the raw feed beside it has the detail.

targets.expr: topk(20, sum by (level, msg) (count_over_time({namespace="boomtime", app_kubernetes_io_name=~"$proc"} |~ `"level":"(WARN|ERROR)"` | json [$__range])))

panels.title: Warnings and errors (live)
panels.description: Every WARN and ERROR record from the boomtime processes, newest first. Expand a line for the full structured payload (job ids, error strings, upstream response bodies).

panels.title: Ingest and aggregation failures
panels.description: The domain-data failure feed: heartbeats that could not be stored, aggregation queries that failed behind the stats endpoints, and rejected ingest writes. Each line here is data the user expected boomtime to have.

targets.expr: {namespace="boomtime", app_kubernetes_io_name=~"$proc"} |~ "failed to store heartbeats|aggregation query failed|derived status failed|failed to store" | json | line_format "{{.level}}  {{.msg}}  {{.err}}"
